response.text:
I don't see the slide attached. Please upload the slide (image or PDF) or tell me which slide in a file to inspect. 

When you do, I will:
- Inspect the slide and chart before making claims (per chart/table caution).
- Give a short summary of the slide and the chart’s trend.
- Cite exactly where the trend appears (slide number or image filename, chart title or position on the slide, and the axis/labels used).

Optional: do you want approximate numeric estimates from the chart or just the qualitative trend?
